children: Overview
US optical networking products maker's Q3 revenue rose, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company returned to GAAP profitability, citing strong demand and manufacturing expansion
Outlook
Applied Optoelectronics sees Q4 revenue between $385 mln and $420 mln
Company expects Q4 non-GAAP gross margin of 29.5% to 31%
Applied Optoelectronics forecasts Q4 non-GAAP net income of $45.9 mln to $60.4 mln
Result Drivers
AI-RELATED DEMAND - Co said accelerating demand for AI-related optical technologies drove record revenue
MANUFACTURING EXPANSION - Co attributed improved profitability and revenue growth to expanded manufacturing capacity in datacenter and CATV businesses
STRATEGIC CUSTOMER AGREEMENT - Co said a new multi-year agreement with a Tier 1 hyperscale datacenter customer improved long-term revenue visibility
